# Synthetic Systems Engineering publication

## SYSE.31 – Keep feedback attributable

### SYSE.31:1 - Problem frame
The developer must distinguish a product failure from missing observation.

### SYSE.31:4 - Solution
Retain candidate, input and oracle identities. Pin B uses seed 220.

### SYSE.31:5 - Example
A package exits successfully but selects no tests; the observation is not_run.

### SYSE.31:7 - Checklist
- Report a wrong-artifact run as unattributable.

### SYSE.31:9 - Consequences
A green result applies only to its checked scope.

### SYSE.31:End
